chunks: Whosoever desires a reward of this world (should remember) that with God are rewards of this world and the next; and God hears all and sees everything.
ai.seo_question: Where are the rewards of this world and the Hereafter found according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to highlight that while worldly rewards are transient and contingent upon divine will, the ultimate, enduring reward belongs to the Hereafter, urging believers to prioritize spiritual gain over material desire. The attributes of 'All-Hearing' and 'All-Seeing' serve as a reminder of God's comprehensive surveillance over both the visible actions and hidden intentions of individuals, reinforcing the concept of *Ihsan* (spiritual awareness).
